neighbours.label: instructions for phone settings and controls (set the phone to vibrate, double tap the button, put it on silent)
fire: Before the meeting starts, switch your phone to silent mode and lay it face down.
Hold the power button for three seconds - the screen will turn off.
To save battery, set your mobile to airplane mode while you sleep.
Swipe down from the top of the screen to open quick settings like brightness.
Triple click the side button - this turns on the magnifier.
In the cinema, turn your ringer off or set the phone to vibrate.
Press volume up and power together to take a screenshot of the display.
Go to settings, tap sounds, and choose a new ringtone for alarms.
quiet: Before the meeting starts, switch your notebook to a fresh page and lay it face down.
Hold the door handle for three seconds and the lock will release.
To save money, set your thermostat a little lower while you sleep.
Swipe the brush from the top of the canvas to blend the sky like a painter.
Triple fold the letter neatly so it fits inside the envelope.
In the cinema, keep your voice down and stay seated during the film.
Press the dough flat with both hands and dust it with flour.
Go to the kitchen, open the drawer, and choose a spoon for the soup.

notes: Top: phone settings in lists and tips; - pole is French/Spanish 'de'.
